lines.text: A person sits still on the floor, upright and quiet, holding a fixed seated pose with almost no movement.
Still seated, the person gently rocks forward and backward, testing small stretches of the arms and legs.
The person begins to move little by little, shifting weight from one hip to the other while keeping the pelvis close to the floor.

The person places both hands on the floor beside the hips, pushes against the floor, and scoots the pelvis forward in several small movements. The feet and hands help the body travel without standing up.
The person stops pushing, settles the pelvis on the floor, and returns to the same upright seated posture as at the beginning. The arms and legs become still.
